cutoff_qa_correction: Initial v1 incorrectly used the fleet-wide 9 Sep cutoff for six machines. Intake inventory proves 029/041/057/070 end 1 Sep mid-day and 118/119 end 20 Aug mid-day. Corrected cutoffs exclude those partial days, without changing method parameters. Initial rates/coverage were rejected, not used for method selection.
selection: All four variants are predeclared. No HPO or choice by shadow burden. Segment selection = longest supported chronological segment, earliest on ties; multiple supported segments require review.
scoring: Score every qualified shadow minute for each supported reference. Phase is attribution/review only, not suppression; unknown onset stays unknown. Retain manual/control source evidence.
limitations: Previously inspected retrospective data, no healthy-negative ground truth; screened reference is not healthy or Active. Research robust scale reuses 08K/08L max(MAD,IQR,floor), not a registry-profile parity claim.
